exampleCollector.title: 🤖 Sparki's Example Collector
exampleCollector.subtitle: Learn how AI learns from examples!
exampleCollector.intro: Hi! I'm Sparki 🤖 AI learns from examples, not magic. I'll show you items, and you sort them into two piles. Let's see if you understand the pattern!
exampleCollector.whichCategory: Which category does this belong to?
exampleCollector.feedbackWrong: ❌ Oops! Try the other pile next time.
exampleCollector.completeBody: You sorted {correct} out of {total} items correctly! You're learning like AI! 🌟
exampleCollector.sparkiComplete: Great job! You figured out the pattern by looking at examples. That's exactly how AI learns—by studying examples and finding patterns. You're an AI expert! 🌟

bodyCodeChain.title: 🤖 Sparki's Body Code Chain
bodyCodeChain.subtitle: Mirror Sparki's movements to learn how code works!
bodyCodeChain.intro: Hi! I'm Sparki! 🤖 In each round, I'll do a sequence of body movements. You watch and remember them, then YOU do the exact same movements!
bodyCodeChain.intro2: It's like learning code—follow the instructions step-by-step. Get it right and you level up! 💪
bodyCodeChain.yourTurnInstruction: Your turn! Tap the actions in order.
bodyCodeChain.feedbackWrongOrder: ❌ Oops! That's not the right order. Watch Sparki again!
bodyCodeChain.feedbackPerfectRound: ✅ Perfect! You copied it exactly! Round {round} complete!
bodyCodeChain.completeBody: You got {correct} out of {total} rounds perfect! 🌟
bodyCodeChain.sparkiComplete: You followed instructions perfectly! That's exactly what code is—a set of steps to follow in the right order. Amazing work, Body Coder! 🌟

softwareExplorer.title: 🗺️ Sparki's Software Explorer
softwareExplorer.subtitle: Discover the tools that help us do amazing things!
softwareExplorer.intro: Hi! I'm Sparki! 🤖 Help me explore a treasure map and discover 6 hidden software tools! Each chest contains a different tool. Your job is to match each task (like "Draw a rainbow") to the right software tool. Can you find them all?
softwareExplorer.intro2: Learn how software is like a toolbox—different tools help us do different things! 🛠️✨
softwareExplorer.tryAgain: ❌ Oops! That's not right. Try again!
softwareExplorer.completeBody: You explored all the tools and became a Software Explorer!
softwareExplorer.sparkiComplete: Awesome! You found all 6 tools! You now understand that software is like a toolbox—each tool helps us do different things. You're officially a Software Explorer! 🌟

fairCode.title: 🤖 Sparki's Fair Code Adventure
fairCode.subtitle: Learn about Ethical Coding!
fairCode.welcomeBody: Hi! I'm Sparki! 🤖 Writing code is awesome, but we need to code FAIRLY! That means thinking about how our code affects everyone. You'll face 6 situations where you choose between Fair Code and Unfair Code. Fair Code = everyone wins! 🤝 Unfair Code = someone gets hurt! 😢 Ready to become an Ethical Coder? Let's go! 💪✨
fairCode.sparkiComplete: You chose fair code every time! That means you understand—REAL power comes from writing code that helps EVERYONE. You're now an Ethical Coder! 🎉 Keep being fair! 💚

s1.situation: You wrote an awesome game! A friend asks: 'Can I have your code?'
s1.fairChoice: Share your code so they can learn! 📚
s1.unfairChoice: Say 'No!' and keep it secret all to yourself! 🤐
s1.explanation: ✅ Sharing helps others learn and makes the world better! Teamwork rocks!

s2.situation: Your app has a bug that makes it crash sometimes. Do you:
s2.fairChoice: Tell everyone about it and fix it! 🔧
s2.unfairChoice: Hide it so people don't know. 🙈
s2.explanation: ✅ Being honest helps people use your app safely! Trust matters!

s3.situation: You're coding an AI. You notice it makes wrong choices for some kids. Do you:
s3.fairChoice: Fix it so it's fair to EVERYONE! 🤝
s3.unfairChoice: Leave it broken for some people. 😞
s3.explanation: ✅ Fair code treats everyone the same! That's what justice looks like!

s4.situation: Your code collects data from users. Should you:
s4.fairChoice: Ask permission and explain what you'll do with it! 🗣️
s4.explanation: ✅ Respecting privacy is SUPER important! People's data = their trust!

s5.situation: You found a cool trick to make your code faster, but it's confusing. Do you:
s5.fairChoice: Add comments so others understand it! 💡
s5.unfairChoice: Leave no notes so only YOU understand it. 🤐
s5.explanation: ✅ Good coders help each other! Clear code = happy team!

s6.situation: Your code could help sick people, but it might take time to build. Do you:
s6.fairChoice: Work hard to build it right, even if it's slow! 🏥
s6.unfairChoice: Rush it and launch it broken to get money fast! 💰
s6.explanation: ✅ Taking time to do it RIGHT means saving lives! That's real power!

worldAI.title: 🌍 Sparki's World AI Helper
worldAI.subtitle: Discover where AI helpers work around the world!
worldAI.welcome: Hi! I'm Sparki! 🤖 AI is all around us! It helps at schools, hospitals, farms, and homes. Your job? Read what someone needs help with, then pick the RIGHT place where AI can help! 🌍 Think carefully—sometimes AI can make mistakes, so we need to be smart about it! Ready to become an AI Expert? 🧠✨
worldAI.welcome2: Learn how AI helpers around the world make places better—and why it's important to check their work! 🧠🌟
worldAI.readNeedPickPlace: Read the need, pick the place! 🌍
worldAI.matchCorrect: ✅ YES! AI helps with that at the {place}! 🎉
worldAI.matchWrong: ❌ Hmm, not quite! Think about where AI would help with that... Try again!
worldAI.qFeedbackCorrect: ✅ Right! AI learns from examples, so sometimes it makes mistakes. That's why we ALWAYS check with a grown-up! 🧠 You're thinking critically! 💡
worldAI.qFeedbackWrong: ❌ Actually, AI can sometimes be wrong! AI learns from examples, so it might make mistakes. That's why we ALWAYS check with a grown-up first! 🧠 Great learning moment! 💡
worldAI.completeBody: You explored all the AI helpers around the world!
worldAI.sparkiComplete: Awesome! You matched real needs with the right places where AI can help. You also know AI isn't perfect—always double-check with a grown-up. You're a World AI Helper! 🌟
